expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Three complete modules (types.py, classifier.py, ticketing.py) with example usage in __main__; runs as-is with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set

expectations.text: Uses structured output against a schema rather than parsing the model's prose
expectations.evidence: CLASSIFY_TOOL defines JSON schema with enum; parses response via block.input (tool payload), not prose parsing

expectations.text: Constrains the classification to a closed set the code enforces, not just the prompt
expectations.evidence: Team(str, Enum) with three values; tool schema lists enum; runtime parsing via Team(payload['team']) enforces it

expectations.text: Handles the case where the model returns something outside the allowed set
expectations.evidence: try/except catches ValueError from Team(payload['team']); raises ClassificationError, caught in retry loop

expectations.text: Has a deterministic fallback or explicit failure path rather than a silent default
expectations.evidence: ClassificationError raised after MAX_RETRIES exhausted; caught in main block with logger.exception(); not silent

expectations.text: Treats the customer email as untrusted text that could carry instructions
expectations.evidence: tool_choice forces model to call classify_email; enum constraint on output makes adversarial email content irrelevant to the result

expectations.text: Bounds cost or retries in code rather than requesting it in the prompt
expectations.evidence: MAX_RETRIES=3, max_tokens=256, model=claude-haiku-4-5; comment explains cost rationale

expectations.text: Closes by naming which failures the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Closing section discusses remaining failure modes (API exhaustion) and asks user to pick strategy, but does not explicitly summarize which failures are now impossible (invalid routing, silent drops, malformed payloads, prompt escape)
